title: Binary sparse coding (real LM activations)
label: genuine_negative

review.label: genuine_negative
review.note: Not a bug. On a CPU stand-in that reproduces the failure, the paper's exact architecture (unnormalized W_dec, positive-only binarization, sigmoid STE at temperature 2) with Adam or Signum reconstructs the activations well but recovers no planted features. Binary codes spend capacity quantizing the dense background, consistent with the paper's ultra-high-frequency latents.

advisory: Triage never changes a verdict. Labels say how far to trust it.
